_comment: Drives load_cell.test under the simavr bridge. spi_ads1220 puts the bridge into ADS1220 register-file + continuous-conversion mode so the chip init's write-then-verify succeeds and continuous-mode reads serve real samples. data_ready_pin (PA1 for [load_cell my_ads1220], PJ3 for [load_cell_probe]) is held low so the firmware reads the ADC continuously. load_cell_probe_trigger hooks the Z step pin (PL3) and synthesizes a ramped 24-bit sample = steps_in_burst * force_per_step on each ADS1220 read while Z is descending, returning 0 during quiet (tare) stretches. With counts_per_gram=100, force_per_step=50 means 0.5 g/step; at the configured probe_speed=10 mm/s on a 400 step/mm Z stepper that's 2000 g/s of ramp, crossing the default 75 g trigger about 38 ms into the descent - well before the 2000 g safety limit. auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires the cartesian endstops on G28 so homing completes; analog_in supplies plausible thermistor readings for heater min/max checks. sim_time keeps simavr free-running with klippy on the same simulated clock.
